title: Gukesh Dommaraju Is on the 2026 TIME100 Next India
text:
Gukesh Dommaraju: TIME100 Next India 2026 Skip to Content Menu Close 
 Subscribe back to list TIME100 Next India 2026 Filter Nov 19, 2026 Gukesh Dommaraju
 by Sharda Ugra CTK/AP In 2024, Gukesh Dommaraju, then 18, became the youngest-ever world chess champion, as well as the first teenager and the first Gen Z champion.
 At the 2026 Chess Olympiad in September, Gukesh delivered a crucial comeback win that was instrumental in India’s securing silver.
 Gukesh’s emergence and win set imaginations alight around the world, and the next world championships, beginning Nov. 25 in Geneva, will be even more significant. In this competition, he will defend his title against Uzbek opponent Javokhir Sindarov, also 20—the first time in the competition’s 140 years that two 20-year-olds will knock heads for their sport’s most valuable prize.
